review_type: Independent generic technical review only; no factual QA verdict or adoption decision
procedural_deviation: Initial permitted manifest display included metadata beyond hash fields; no referenced file was accessed.

neutral_characterization.meaning: Known limitations are intentionally characterized; matches do not mean safety approval.

findings.description: Low-level validator does not establish a complete/local/controlling header.
High-level separator/header heuristic accepts malformed table blocks and separator headers.
Escaped terminal pipe is treated as a complete outer boundary.
Nested child extraction omits governing parent and other external context.
Bounds can be normalized or raise IndexError before validation.
Exactness applies to whitespace-trimmed Unicode spans in supplied text.
Restricted table grammar; no fenced-code/container interpretation.
Paragraphs are LF/CRLF blank-delimited chunks, not Markdown syntax nodes.
List boundaries do not implement full Markdown syntax or parent-context collection.
Restricted-format successes are backed by neutral fixtures, not semantic evidence.

required_usage: Treat high-level extractors as restricted-format aids only after independent source-format checks.
Do not use low-level table validator to prove complete or controlling headers.
Check actual header/separator/intervening block, unescaped outer pipes, source containers and selected fact relevance independently.
Inspect and include governing parents, headings, definitions, exceptions and external conditions when relevant.
Preserve original decoded Unicode text and record byte hash, decoding and newline policy; use Python code-point offsets.
Grade every asked fact independently from its same entry; exact span matching supplies no semantic or case verdict.
changes_needed_for_stronger_claims: Validate bounds before indexing and explicitly validate optional header spans.
Validate complete local non-separator headers and the intervening table block.
Reject unsupported structures or use source-position-preserving Markdown parsing.
